_doc: Doctrine v2 Part XXIII.2 — Waiver Registry. Append-only. Reviewed monthly. Expired waivers fail CI on the next run.

_schema.rule: string — lint rule id: determinism | canonical-rename | no-evasion
_schema.line: number | undefined — 1-indexed; omit for whole-file waiver (use FILE in inline marker)
_schema.sunset: string — ISO-8601 date; CI fails the next run after this date if waiver still present
_schema.owner: string — custodian responsible for closing the waiver

waivers.justification: Dynamic ESM import of @xenova/transformers lacks shipped types; @ts-ignore is the targeted local mitigation until the upstream package ships types or the import is moved behind a typed shim.

Canon RAG ingest is intentionally best-effort at the orchestrator boundary; swallowing here protects the synchronous user-facing path. Replace with structured warn-log in Phase 9 (Agent stack hardening).
Catch block is the documented fallback recovery path for the LLM variant generator. Replace with structured logger and typed error in Phase 9.
eslint-disable for console.error is required because the pool-level error handler runs before the structured logger is initialized; bootstrapping path. Replace with deferred logger in Phase 9.
